title: Skull
body:
“Wow! That must've costed a fortune. 💀💀💀”


The Skull is a quest object. It can be obtained from the top of Skull Rock by destroying the hatch using explosives (3 small bombs).

You can also obtain it at the acidlands by killing some skeletons, with a still not confirmed drop rate.

it sells for 250$ being burnt or not, at the resource hub.

It also could be obtained from the 2024 Halloween event from the blood moon event.

Details

The Skull, in its initial state, is simply a decorative object. However, if taken down to the Magma Caves and left near a heat source, the Skull will begin to burn. As it burns, it turns a deeper, darker shade of red, until it has completely burnt. At this point, the skull will emit a black flame particle and be renamed the Burning Skull. This can take a variable amount of time, usually about 5-10 minutes, which can greatly increase if the server is lagging. The Burning Skull is used to acquire the Emberbane; should a player wish to acquire the Burning Skull, it is best to check the object to see if it is making progress, or if the name has changed.
